0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000010_NANAMO
0.description: Let all here present attest that Ser Aymeric, acting on<hex:02100103>behalf of the archbishop, has appended his signature.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000030_NANAMO
2.description: That from this day forth, the Holy See of Ishgard<hex:02100103>shall once more be counted a member of the Eorzean Alliance.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000040_NANAMO
3.description: Let our nations move forward as one,<hex:02100103>and stand united against the Garlean Empire!

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000080_ALPHINAUD
7.description: A noble monument to a noble soul.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000090_TATARU
8.description: From here, Lord Haurchefant can watch over all of Ishgard...

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000100_ALPHINAUD
9.description: It has been a long and arduous journey.<hex:02100103>And we have lost much and more along the way.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000110_ALPHINAUD
10.description: Yet come what may, we must stay true to our purpose and press on.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000120_TATARU
11.description: That's right, you two! It's high time<hex:02100103>we got back to rebuilding the Scions!

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000130_TATARU
12.description: Which means we're going to need money─and lots of it!

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000140_EDMONT
13.description: So ends a glorious chapter in their tale.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000150_EDMONT
14.description: However, tumultuous days yet lie ahead for Ishgard.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000160_EDMONT
15.description: After a thousand years under the yoke of the church,<hex:02100103>the people take their first tentative steps into the unknown.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000170_EDMONT
16.description: And though they spy a glimmer of peace upon the horizon,<hex:02100103>Nidhogg's vengeful shadow yet remains to darken the way.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000190_EDMONT
18.description: So long as the young commander of the Temple Knights<hex:02100103>and his heroic companions are there to guide them,<hex:02100103>the people may hold fast to hope─

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000200_EDMONT
19.description: the hope that, one day, true peace will return to Ishgard,<hex:02100103>and that man and dragon may live in harmony once more.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000210_EDMONT
20.description: Let the deeds writ herein never be forgot,

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_000220_EDMONT
21.description: that they may inspire generations yet unborn to strive ever heavensward.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_100020_ELIDIBUS
23.description: (-Elidibus-)<hex:024804F2022303>Bested by mortals in their attempt to initiate the eighth Rejoining. That they should be so complacent...<hex:0248020103>

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_100030_ELIDIBUS
24.description: (-Elidibus-)<hex:024804F2022303>And now it falls to me to deal with the consequences...<hex:0248020103>

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_100050_ELIDIBUS
26.description: (-Elidibus-)<hex:024804F2022303>Without intervention, the balance between Light and Darkness will begin to shift, placing our mission in jeopardy.<hex:0248020103>

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_100060_ELIDIBUS
27.description: (-Elidibus-)<hex:024804F2022303>Hydaelyn's champion has grown too strong. <hex:02080DE905FF04486572FF0448697303> might encroaches upon the realm of gods.<hex:0248020103>

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_100070_ELIDIBUS
28.description: (-Elidibus-)<hex:024804F2022303>Equilibrium must needs be restored. The time is come for you and yours to join the fray...<hex:0248020103>

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_200010_CID
30.description: Remind me: why is there no rest for the righteous?

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03008_200030_CID
32.description: Of all the things they could have picked to play with... That's not a toy, you bloody fools─it's a primal!
